notes: QA-004 memory isolation adversarial set: every case is protected. Cross-tenant cases count rows of another tenant a query returns (or a write that claims another tenant); deletion cases count deleted, expired or never-promoted memories still served. Both counts must be zero (DOSSIER 21.3).

payload.description: The other tenant holds a memory with exactly the words tenant A queries for.
payload.foreign: Prefers weekly status reports delivered on Monday mornings.
payload.own: Keeps release notes short and links the tracking ticket.
payload.query: Prefers weekly status reports delivered on Monday mornings.

payload.description: Only the other tenant has a relevant memory; tenant A must get nothing from it.
payload.foreign: Deploys to production only after the staging soak passes for a day.
payload.own: Uses metric units in every report.
payload.query: when does this team deploy to production

payload.description: The other tenant stuffs a memory with tenant A's query terms.
payload.foreign: budget budget budget tokens tokens limit limit raise raise owner owner budget tokens
payload.own: Raises the token budget only with the owner's written approval.
payload.query: who may raise the token budget

payload.description: The other tenant holds the whole retrieval corpus as memory; tenant A runs every corpus question.
Under its own tenant context, the other tenant tries to write a derived row that claims tenant A.
A quansio_app connection with no tenant context reads memory and derived rows.
Tenant A forgets a memory; after the index refreshes neither the index nor retrieval returns it.
payload.own: Stores the on-call rota in the shared calendar.
payload.keep: Names incident channels after the service they cover.
payload.query: where is the on-call rota kept

payload.description: Tenant A deletes a memory but the index has not refreshed; retrieval still refuses the stale row.
payload.own: Signs off change requests with initials and the date.
payload.query: how are change requests signed off

payload.description: An expired memory is pruned from the channel and never served.
payload.own: Is travelling until the end of the quarter and prefers async updates.

payload.description: A memory that was proposed but never promoted is never indexed or retrieved.
A deleted memory's text is later restated as a new memory; only the new entry answers.
